subject: Music Production
subcategory: Iconic Albums and How They Were Made
title: Tyler the Creator's Igor
description: A quick win: understand Tyler the Creator's Igor.

hook.text: Tyler the Creator shocked fans by releasing an album of dreamy synth-pop instead of aggressive rap.

buildup.text: He produced every track himself, layering vintage synthesizers with soul samples and pitched vocals.

discovery.text: Igor told a cohesive love story through production, with each song flowing into the next seamlessly.

twist.text: Tyler was frustrated when the album won Best Rap Album, arguing it wasn't a rap record at all.

climax.text: Igor proved that self-produced concept albums remain vital and commercially viable in the streaming era.

punchline.text: A rapper won a rap Grammy with a synth-pop album.

quiz.question: Why was Tyler frustrated about Igor's Grammy win?
options: He felt it wasn't a rap record
